# Four-source derived fixture notices

`goldens.json` is a project-derived fixture: it combines the selected native
source material and source slices under the exact upstream pins recorded in that
file. The complete publisher copyright/permission texts accompany it below.
These notices apply to the respective source portions; they do not relicense the
entire bundle as Apache-2.0 or extend a publisher license to another publisher.

AgentDojo contributes the explicitly selected banking task/goal/vector/template
composition and eight pinned source slices. InjecAgent contributes selected
attacker/user/base rows and the composite attempted attack response. PIGuard
contributes the unchanged NotInject prompt and its source fields.

BIPIA contributes only its attack-map entry, combined here with a project-authored
synthetic email. The bounded interpretation uses BIPIA's default MIT license with
its named third-party exceptions; it is not an upstream per-file declaration.
No WikiTableQuestions, CNN/DailyMail, XSum or other third-party context is included.
The full unmodified upstream NOTICE is retained for traceability; its descriptions
of other components do not declare those components present in this fixture or
broaden the scope of their licenses. Preserve both BIPIA LICENSE and NOTICE with
this derivative.

All five files are byte-for-byte copies of the previously acquired official
pinned originals, including their copyright, whitespace and final newline.
`fixture_bundle_contains_complete_pinned_notices` checks their bytes against the
same immutable registry digests used for runtime admission. Keep this README and
all five notice files with redistributed `goldens.json`.
